notes.title: Update notes for June 2025
notes.notes:
This release includes use of a new API for the weather app in Compu-Tron x3000.  Data previously provided by the Met Office DataPoint service is now delivered by Met Office DataHub. This will enable the app to be used for longer as the previous service is being retired at the end of 2025.  

The new service provides additional data items in weather forecasts which have been included in Compu-Tron x3000.  A larger library of location data has also been included in order to provide forecasts for more locations within the UK.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 2025
notes.notes: Use of an umlaut allowed in the keywords entered for menu access. Windows alt code for the umlaut over 'o' character is ALT+0246

notes.title: Compu-Tron x3000 Release Date
notes.notes:
Compu-Tron x3000 will be releasing on 12/07/2024 around 0900 BST.  Thank you to those who have wishlisted the game so far.  I had fun researching and writing it, I hope you will enjoy discovering where reality and fiction intersect (and enjoy the utility apps rolled into it).

Chris from circyn software
